name: Reacher
description: Jack Reacher, a veteran military police investigator, has just recently entered civilian life. Reacher is a drifter, carrying no phone and the barest of essentials as he travels the country and explores the nation he once served.

videos.title: Welcome to Margrave
videos.overview: Reacher is wrongly accused of murder while visiting the small town of Margrave, GA.

videos.title: First Dance
videos.overview: When more victims are discovered, Reacher attempts to get answers but is set up. Roscoe receives a threatening message.

videos.title: Spoonful
videos.overview: Reacher and Finlay’s investigation into the missing Spivey leads them into a confrontation with Kliner Sr. Roscoe learns unsettling news about Reacher.

videos.title: In a Tree
videos.overview: As the danger increases, Reacher and Roscoe grow closer and they make plans to meet with their contact from Homeland Security.

videos.title: No Apologies
videos.overview: As the mystery deepens, Reacher teams up with an old colleague and Finlay makes a shocking discovery.

videos.title: Papier
videos.overview: As the town is rocked by another murder, Reacher heads to New York and learns the truth about the illegal business in Margrave while Roscoe faces danger in the woods.

videos.title: Reacher Said Nothing
videos.overview: Reacher springs a trap and then gets trapped himself.

videos.title: Pie
videos.overview: Reacher leads a rescue mission at the warehouse that ends in a showdown.

videos.title: ATM
videos.overview: Reacher and Neagley investigate the murder of a member of 110th, a group of Special investigators assembled by Reacher, only to realize the whole unit may be at risk.

videos.title: What Happens in Atlantic City
videos.overview: The investigation into Franz's murder takes Reacher and the surviving members of his former Army unit to Atlantic City where the mystery deepens, danger awaits, and an old flame is rekindled.

videos.title: Picture Says a Thousand Words
videos.overview: After more of his friends fall victim, Reacher forges an uneasy alliance with a dogged detective, and their only clue in the case leads the 110th to a troubling discovery.

videos.title: A Night at the Symphony
videos.overview: Reacher and his team head to Boston to track down a political aide with insider knowledge of a top secret military-defense contract that may be the reason behind their friends' deaths.

videos.title: Burial
videos.overview: Neagley and Dixon discover shocking information about an old friend in Denver while Reacher and O'Donnell learn more about the nefarious and mysterious A.M..

videos.title: New York's Finest
videos.overview: As the mystery continues to unfold, Reacher and his team set a trap to even the score.

videos.title: The Man Goes Through
videos.overview: As the team close in on Langston, two members of the 110th face danger, compelling Reacher to devise a dangerous plan to rescue them.

videos.title: Fly Boy
videos.overview: Reacher and Neagley make a final desperate attempt to save O’Donnell and Dixon, stop A.M. and avenge their friends’ murder.

videos.title: Persuader
videos.overview: Reacher's attempt to thwart a kidnapping brings him into contact with mysterious businessman Zachary Beck.

videos.title: Truckin'
videos.overview: Tasked with transporting cargo for his new employer Zachary Beck, Reacher must juggle the involvement of the DEA and a nosy new associate.

videos.title: Number 2 with a Bullet
videos.overview: As a rising body count threatens his undercover position, Reacher makes a dangerous play to secure Beck's trust.

videos.title: Dominique
videos.overview: Reacher reunites with Duffy and Villanueva and finally shares the painful details of his history with Xavier Quinn.

videos.title: Smackdown
videos.overview: When a DEA tragedy puts the entire mission at risk, Reacher, Duffy, and Villanueva improvise a drastic plan to save their cover.

videos.title: Smoke on the Water
videos.overview: Reacher is torn between his desire to kill Quinn and his promise to Duffy to save Teresa.

videos.title: L.A. Story
videos.overview: After Reacher and Duffy travel to Los Angeles to arrange a deal, Neagley arrives in Maine to help Reacher get answers.

videos.title: Unfinished Business
videos.overview: Reacher finally faces off with both Paulie and Quinn.
